narrative.headline: 2022 Chevrolet Silverado 1500: engine and transmission lead owner complaints
narrative.summary: Across 549 owner complaints to NHTSA, engine problems are the most common at 210 reports (38%), followed by power train issues at 152 (28%) — owners describe transmission slipping and lost acceleration. Electrical system reports come next at 122 (22%). Safety incidents are rare: engine reports include 3 fires, and the electrical and brake categories each have 1 crash.
